configurations.name: sdsm_producer_topic
configurations.description: Kafka topic to which the sensor data sharing service will produce SDSMs.

configurations.name: detection_consumer_topic
configurations.description: Kafka topic from which the sensor data sharing service will consume Detected Objects.

configurations.name: sensor_id
configurations.description: Unique id of sensor for which to publish SDSMS

configurations.name: record_detection_metrics
configurations.description: Bool flag to indicate whether to record detection metrics for the sensor data sharing service.

configurations.name: reference_proj_string
configurations.description: Geospatial Proj string that describes the WGS84 reference location of the infrastructure to be used in creation of SDSMs. Detections will use a cartesian offset from this reference location.
